fusions.name: Steady Regard
fusions.desc: Fires a spore at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 26 necrotic damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It leaves the target [Marked] for 10 seconds and gives it Rot for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spore Print
fusions.desc: Looses 2 spores at once, each dealing 3 nature damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds. The mark spreads on its own to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Watchful Network
fusions.desc: Restores 8 health, and for 20 seconds your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Seen Infection
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
